hero.title: Turn quality data into actionable intelligence.
hero.description: OpenQMS embeds AI into FMEA, 8D, process analysis, and knowledge reuse so quality engineers can identify risk, validate causes, and retain experience faster.

ai.title: AI is the quality engineer's copilot—not a black-box decision maker.
ai.description: The system retrieves evidence from quality context, fuses it into suggestions, and writes back only after human confirmation. Every suggestion retains its source, confidence, and audit trail.

stages.title: Connect quality context
stages.body: FMEA, CAPA, SPC, IQC, MES, supplier data, and lessons learned

stages.title: Retrieve through multiple paths
stages.body: Knowledge graph, semantic search, rule engines, and historical cases

stages.title: Fuse and generate suggestions
stages.body: Candidate deduplication, ranking, context enrichment, and structured LLM output

stages.title: Confirm and audit
stages.body: Permission gates, human approval, source labels, and audit logs

useCases.title: FMEA recommendations
useCases.body: Assist with functions, failures, causes, controls, and optimization actions.

useCases.title: 8D causes and actions
useCases.body: Orchestrate quality data across 12 stages to produce explainable candidates.

useCases.title: Quality knowledge Q&A
useCases.body: Use hybrid RAG over historical documents and nodes, scoped by user permissions.

useCases.title: Trend interpretation and drafting
useCases.body: Interpret quality trends and draft 8D steps and management-review content.

ai.principle: AI does not bypass business rules or replace engineering approval. It brings quality knowledge from across the system into the decision workflow.

capabilities.title: A complete quality loop beneath the AI layer

items.title: Supply-chain quality
items.body: Supplier performance · Risk alerts · Customer quality

items.title: Governance and compliance
items.body: Audits · Management review · RBAC · Multiple factories

architecture.title: Deployable, extensible, and built to evolve
architecture.description: Relational data preserves transactions and audit trails, graph data powers knowledge links, and configurable providers connect AI services.

openSource.title: Start from the source and build your quality system
openSource.description: Explore the source and deployment docs, or use a Viewer account to experience the complete quality workflow.
